title: Strategic cadence mesh and capacity-gated initiative sequencing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a prescriptive playbook and decision surface to map company-level OKRs to a time-sequenced set of initiatives that are gated by engineering capacity and risk tolerance. This ticket captures the end-to-end proposal: cadence rules, capacity slices, release lanes, gating criteria for canaries/fallbacks, escalation triggers, and a lightweight tooling spec for the roadmap console to surface initiative sequencing and gating state. Goal is to reduce cross-team rework caused by over-commitment, improve predictability of company OKR delivery, and provide an operational handoff artifact for PM/Eng/Design during planning cycles.
acceptance_criteria: A one-page playbook describing cadence mesh, capacity slicing, and gating criteria is approved by Eng and Design leads
A sample mapping of Q2 company OKRs to sequenced initiatives (with capacity estimates) is reviewed and signed off by GTM and Platform PMs
Roadmap console mock shows gating state and sequencing lanes for at least two example initiatives
A reproducible checklist and template for cycle planning that teams can apply in the next sprint planning window

decision_log: 2026-03-01: Adopted 'three-lane' sequencing model (Core, Dependent, Experimental) to express execution priority and rollback strictness.
2026-03-08: Use combined score of capacity and infra risk to gate start of Core lane initiatives; threshold set to 0.75 for go/no-go in default configuration.
2026-03-12: Roadmap console will surface gating state as an explicit badge and include one-click links to the capacity estimate and incident history for reviewers.
